title: Aircraft
note: Community receiver reports, not an official air-traffic feed: never use for safety. Positions older than 5 minutes are hidden. No callsign, registration or owner is shown.

title: Satellites (predicted)
note: Positions are predicted from published orbit elements, not observed; the element date is shown. Elements older than 7 days are hidden.
reason: Licence restricted: waits for the owner's review (H11). Orbit propagation unavailable: sgp4 not in the lock (add to requirements/geo.in with pip-tools in a follow-up).

title: Earthquakes
note: USGS events are revised after first report; the revision time and the source link are shown with each event.
reason: Licence restricted: waits for the owner's review (H11).

title: Ships
note: Ship positions are not shown: the AIS feed is blocked.
reason: The owner signs in and creates an aisstream API key (H12), stores AISSTREAM_API_KEY in .env, and the terms shown at sign-in allow reuse of the AIS data; then T111 runs again.
